name: revolved-wall-spline
why: A bell with a spline wall from a 20 mm base to a 5 mm neck, 45 tall, 1 mm wall open at both ends, by revolve's wall option: the inset of a revolved spline is its exact offset, measured by the kernel point by point as it is built, and measure_wall_thickness reads it back as 1 mm everywhere. The open ends come out open because the cavity runs 2 mm past each.
